d:
You don’t know it yet, but you need meditation.
In this clean Hindi standup comedy video, I’ve shared my real Vipassana Meditation journey — dealing with overthinking, stress, silence, emotional challenges during the course, and how meditation slowly changed my mindset and daily life.
This is a personal, family-friendly standup comedy set based on real experiences, mindfulness, self-improvement, and mental health. If you’ve ever struggled with anxiety, stress, or finding peace in life, you’ll relate to this one.
Meditation | Stand Up Comedy | Rakesh Addlakha
